definitions: To make a noticeable difference or significant progress in a situation or towards a goal.
To have a substantial impact or effect on something, especially in a business or project context.
examples: His new strategy really moved the needle on sales.
We need ideas that will move the needle, not just minor adjustments.
Does this change move the needle for customer satisfaction?
pastTenses: moved the needle (simple past), has/have moved the needle (present perfect), moved the needle (past perfect)
